reports.title: Trane Technologies Reports Strong Third-Quarter Results;

lines: •The Company expects full-year 2026 reported revenue growth of approximately 13.5 percent and organic revenue growth of approximately 11 percent versus full-year 2025.
•The Company expects GAAP continuing EPS for full-year 2026 of approximately $15.00 to $15.10, including $0.20 for non-GAAP adjustments.
The Company expects adjusted continuing EPS for full- year 2026 of $15.20 to $15.30.
